source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    unique = set(cells)
    split = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (v for rr, line in enumerate(grid) if rr != r for v in line):
            split = ("h", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[0][c]
            if all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) and sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) == h:
                split = ("v", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("separator not found")
    axis, i = split
    if axis == "h":
        before = [v for row in grid[:i] for v in row]
        target = grid[i + 1:]
    else:
        before = [row[c] for row in grid for c in range(i)]
        target = [row[i + 1:] for row in grid]
    before_colors = set(before)
    target_counts = Counter(v for row in target for v in row)
    shared = before_colors & set(target_counts)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"expected one shared color, got {shared}")
    common = next(iter(shared))
    dominant = target_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[common if v == dominant else 3 for v in row] for row in target]
'''
